business_summary: Zodiac Energy Limited engages in the installation of solar power generation plants and related items primarily in India and internationally. The company offers solar water heaters; and grid connected solar PV systems, rooftop solar PV systems, off grid solar PV systems, solar pumping solutions, building integrated PV systems, etc. It also engages in design, supply, testing and commissioning, and operation and maintenance of the solar power plants, as well as turnkey solutions for renewable energy power plants. In addition, the company provides ground mounted solar solutions, wind farm solutions, hybrid solutions, floating solar solutions, solar tree solutions, car parking solar solutions, and battery energy storage system solutions. The company serves the renewable energy, solar energy, residential rooftop solar, commercial and industrial solar, institutional solar, and utility-scale solar markets. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.
